models.title: TCFormer, finger dataset subject S01, 2 fingers, executed movement
models.trained_on: Finger dataset (KiltHub) subject S01, ME specialist, own earlier sessions only, seed 0, no cross-subject pretraining (25 epochs per stage)
models.protocol: chronological, trial-level, session-held-out (pretrain on earlier sessions, fine-tune on first 30% of the last session, evaluate on the rest)
models.warning: Personal model of subject S01: 128-channel BioSemi recordings resampled to 100 Hz; meaningless for other people or other EEG caps.
